summary: Iteration 95: tested the PNG share card (GET /api/tarot/shared/{id}/card.png plus the 'Offrir cette carte' button) and the admin 'Viralité Tarot' dashboard (GET /api/admin/tarot-share/top plus the admin tab). Backend: 9/9 pytest passed. Frontend: the public download works, and the admin tab works when logged in as admin with a real Supabase session (nadine.zebdi@gmail.com, created through service-role generate_link + verify, then put into localStorage). Both features work. Only minor PNG design issues were found.

minor.issue: Major arcana have no 'symbole' in the stored data, so every major card falls back to ☉ (La Lune shows a sun). Use a per-arcana symbol map (e.g. ☽ for La Lune) or a neutral glyph.
HEAD request returns 405. Some link-preview crawlers send HEAD first. Consider adding a HEAD route.

Content-Disposition puts the raw first_name in the filename with no sanitisation. A name with quotes or non-ASCII characters (é) can break the header or the latin-1 encoding. Sanitise or use filename*=UTF-8''.
On an exception it returns 200 with an 'error' key instead of a 5xx. It also creates a new AsyncIOMotorClient on every call; reuse the shared client.

issues: Minor-arcana symbol uses the suit colour from the data (#7DD3FC light blue heart), which is off-palette against the navy/gold/cream design.
The 'Droite' label in gold (GOLD) on the cream (PARCHMENT) minor card has low contrast. 'Renversée' in MUTED on navy is also faint.
Large empty band (~250px) between the teaser and the footer when fil_conducteur is short. Consider vertical centring or showing conseil_final.
Leftover test row 'TEST_Camille' (from iteration 94) shows in the production-facing ranking. Clean up TEST_ shared_tirages.

action_items: Optional: map major-arcana symbols in the PNG renderer (La Lune shows ☉)
Optional: improve the 'Droite' label contrast on cream minor cards and keep the symbol colour in the gold/navy palette
Optional: sanitise first_name in the Content-Disposition filename
Optional: delete the TEST_ shared_tirages from MongoDB
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py tarot-share/top: swallowing exceptions into a 200 response hides failures. Raise HTTPException(500) instead.
admin.py: new Motor client on every request. Reuse the shared db connection.
card.png: the PNG render is synchronous PIL work inside an async endpoint, so it blocks the event loop (~100ms+). Wrap it in run_in_threadpool. Cache-Control 24h is fine.
TiragePartage.downloadCard uses alert() for errors. A toast would match the design system.
